meta.name_zh: 失能者個案管理-個案主檔
meta.data_description_zh:
1. 資料所屬單位為衛福部長期照顧司，聯絡窗口資訊：
財團法人國家衛生研究院張小姐
電話： (05)620-4000 分機 51245
電子信箱： changyw@nhri.edu.tw。
2. 資料年度為 2021、2022年。
3. 本資料庫收錄個案皆符合失能資格。
meta.notes_zh:
1. 本檔案僅能與下方「主鍵與比對欄位」說明的檔案串檔，本手冊末頁有串檔說明
附件，再請參考。
※本中心資料庫業經去識別化處理，刪除姓名、地址等可直接識別欄位，如有身分證
字號、院所代碼、投保單位代號、統一編號、出生日期、就醫日期、入院日期等欄位
均經屏蔽處理，且相關資料僅能於本部設置之獨立作業區內使用，並攜出經審核通過
之統計結果，以確保資料應用及其揭露方式已無從識別特定當事人。
meta.primary_keys_raw:
本檔案與居家醫師個案指派單（W_LTC_CMS_FH100）、照顧計畫-輔具
(W_LTC_CMS_QD113)、失能者個案管理-評估/計畫(W_LTC_CMS_CA110)、照會單
(W_LTC_CMS_QD111)比對之唯一鍵值為流水號：OBJID。
meta.data_description_en: 1. The data unit is the Department of Long-term Care under the Ministry of Health and Welfare. Contact information: Ms. Chang from the National Health Research Institute; phone: (05)620-4000 ext. 51245; email: changyw@nhri.edu.tw. 2. The data covers years 2021 and 2022. 3. All cases in this database meet the eligibility criteria for long-term care.
meta.notes_en:
1. This file can only be linked with the 'Key and Matching Fields' described below, see attachment on the last page of this manual for details.
※This center's database has been de-identified, with personal information such as names and addresses removed. Only fields like national health insurance numbers, facility codes, employer codes, unified numbers, dates of birth, medical visit dates, admission dates have been masked, and the data can only be used within a dedicated operational area of this department, and statistical results reviewed and approved before being carried out to ensure that the data cannot be linked back to specific individuals.
meta.primary_keys_en: this file compares with home physician case referral form (W_LTC_CMS_FH100), care plan-assistive device (W_LTC_CMS_QD113), disabled person case management-evaluation/plan (W_LTC_CMS_CA110), consultation form (W_LTC_CMS_QD111) by unique key value: OBJID.
